fullTextZH: 你好！今天，我要说说自己的故事。
fullTextEN: Hello! Today, I want to talk about my own story.
I was born.

fullTextZH: 可是，本来我是不应该出生的。
fullTextEN: However, I was not supposed to be born.

fullTextZH: 我的亲生爸爸和妈妈以为我是男的，
fullTextEN: My biological father and mother thought I was a boy,
so they wanted to have me.

fullTextZH: 可是，他们发现我是女的，
fullTextEN: But they found out I was a girl,
not a boy.
I heard they were very disappointed.
But, there was no way,
because I was already born.
When I was 8 months old,
they couldn't afford to raise me,
and they didn't have money to pay the fine.

fullTextZH: 你们知道，在中国，我们有独生子女政策，
fullTextEN: You know, in China, we have the one-child policy,

fullTextZH: 所以，如果你生很多孩子，
fullTextEN: so if you have many children,
you have to pay a fine.
I am the sixth child in our family,

fullTextZH: 所以，我的亲生爸爸和妈妈要交
fullTextEN: so my biological father and mother had to pay
a lot of fines.
Yes, they don't have money to pay the fine,
so, they want to send me away.

fullTextZH: 我听说，他们问了很多人，
fullTextEN: I heard that they asked many people,
but, I was very ugly when I was young,
so, no one wanted me.
Yes, now I'm not ugly,
I know.
Okay,
but, there was one person, she wanted me.
Who is she?
She is my current sister.
My sister is called Ah Hua.
Why did Ah Hua want me?
Because she didn't have a younger sister,
she wanted a younger sister.

fullTextZH: 也因为，她看到邻居有一个女的，
fullTextEN: Also because, she saw a neighbor had a girl,
also adopted,

fullTextZH: 可是，她的养父和养母对她不好。
fullTextEN: but, her adoptive father and mother were not good to her.

fullTextZH: 所以，阿华担心，如果我被别人领养，
fullTextEN: So, Ah Hua worried that if I were adopted by others,
others would not be good to me.

fullTextZH: 所以，阿华告诉他的妈妈，
fullTextEN: So, Ah Hua told his mother,
She said, 'Let's adopt her.'
Yes, so they adopted me.

fullTextZH: 其实，我的亲生家庭和现在的家庭，
fullTextEN: Actually, my biological family and my current family,
they are relatives.
Actually, Ah Hua is my cousin,

fullTextZH: 但是，现在她是我的姐姐。
fullTextEN: but now she is my sister.
My current mother,

fullTextZH: 也就是我的养母，告诉我，
fullTextEN: who is my adoptive mother, told me,

fullTextZH: 当时，她付了150块给我的亲生妈妈。
fullTextEN: at that time, she paid 150 yuan to my biological mother.

fullTextZH: 听说，我的亲生妈妈不高兴，
fullTextEN: I heard my biological mother was unhappy,
dissatisfied.

fullTextZH: 现在，你猜猜，我的亲生家庭爱我吗？
fullTextEN: Now, do you guess, does my biological family love me?
Of course, they love me very much.

fullTextZH: 我的爸爸是一个不好的丈夫，
fullTextEN: My father is not a good husband,
but he loves me very much.

fullTextZH: 我的妈妈有很多、很多缺点，
fullTextEN: My mother has many, many shortcomings,
but she also loves me very much.
I have, I have two older brothers,
one older sister,
They all love me very much.

fullTextZH: 其实，我从小就知道，我不是亲生的，
fullTextEN: Actually, I knew from a young age that I was not biological,
I am adopted.

fullTextZH: 因为，我现在的家庭和亲生的家庭不远，
fullTextEN: Because my current family is not far from my biological family,
Very close,

fullTextZH: 所以，我从小就知道，我是领养的，
fullTextEN: so I knew from a young age that I was adopted,
not biological.
So, I don't mind.

fullTextZH: 我常常告诉别人我的故事，
fullTextEN: I often tell others my story,
They feel very surprised,
But I feel, um,
It's nothing.

fullTextZH: 其实，我认识很多、很多人，
fullTextEN: Actually, I know many, many people,
They are also adopted.

fullTextZH: 有的人，他们恨他们的亲生爸爸妈妈，
fullTextEN: Some people, they hate their biological parents,

fullTextZH: 他们不喜欢现在的爸爸妈妈，
fullTextEN: They don't like their current parents,

fullTextZH: 可是，我不恨我的亲生爸爸妈妈，
fullTextEN: But I don't hate my biological parents,
But I also don't love them.
I don't care about them.
I am very lucky,

fullTextZH: 因为，我现在的家人很爱我。
fullTextEN: Because my current family loves me very much.

fullTextZH: 所以，亲生还是领养，对我不重要。
fullTextEN: So, whether biological or adopted, it doesn't matter to me.

fullTextZH: 你觉得我的故事奇怪不奇怪？
fullTextEN: Do you think my story is strange or not?
